result.title: Incentive-Responsive Agents: A Principal-Agent Framework, Metric Suite, and Runtime Architecture for Long-Lived Personal AI Agents
result.comment: 33 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Real-LLM experiment (240 runs) plus simulation; code and data included. Correspondence: jipu.su@geely.com; jeepsu@cityu.edu.hk
result.summary: Personal AI agents now persist: they hold accounts, mailboxes, long-term memory, and open-ended task streams, yet the dominant way to improve them remains capability-side: prompt engineering, larger models, longer thinking, and retrieval. We argue that long-lived agents are missing an incentive layer. We formalize an incentive not as text in a prompt but as a runtime contract over the agent's operating point (model tier, test-time compute, memory budget, tool authority, task priority, verification, and compensation) that the agent's policy must causally consume. We develop a principal-agent model with hidden effort, a contractible operating point, and costly verification. We derive (i) a non-consumption invariance principle separating genuine incentives from prompt-level persuasion, (ii) a persistence-as-discount theorem making identity continuity a precondition for sustained effort, (iii) an incentive-capability exchange-rate frontier yielding a per-task routing rule, and (iv) a Goodhart bound for multi-channel verification, plus a three-channel decomposition of mechanism gains (allocation, verification, continuation). A 240-run real-LLM experiment with two models and 60 verifiable tasks shows that prompt-level incentive framing has no detectable effect (p = 0.62), whereas runtime allocation raises success on the hardest task family from 0.60 to 1.00 (p = 0.008) at 4.8x price-weighted cost; the exchange-rate theorem predicts the break-even baseline at 0.21. A 20-seed, 3,000-task simulation shows resource ROI rising from 7.09 to 16.67 and gaming falling from 0.333 to 0.115. Code, simulator, and all results are released; live deployment remains future work.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从委托—代理视角提出长期运行的个人 AI agent 缺少「激励层」，把激励形式化为对运行点（模型档位、测试时计算、记忆预算、工具权限、验证与补偿）的运行期契约，并给出理论性质、指标与运行架构，辅以真实 LLM 实验和仿真。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「运行点契约」把测试时计算、验证开销与继续/停止决策放在同一成本—收益框架下，或可为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的预算分配与验证价值评估提供问题表述上的启发，但无视觉或多模态状态层面联系，需核查其交换率与 Goodhart 界是否适用于推理期状态更新。
